Specification: This module specifies Lamport's bakery mutual exclusion algorithm for N processes, using the PlusCal translation that introduces control-state variable pc and per-process state variables num, flag, unchecked, max, and nxt. The spec models the algorithm as a concurrent transition system with weak fairness for each process when it is outside the noncritical-state guard, and it states both safety and liveness properties including mutual exclusion, deadlock freedom, and starvation freedom. The file also defines a strong inductive invariant capturing type correctness and ordering relationships used in the bakery argument, while explicitly omitting the original TLAPS proof from the source specification.
IfThenElse: IF unchecked[self] # {} THEN /\ \E i \in unchecked[self]: /\ unchecked' = [unchecked EXCEPT ![self] = unchecked[self] \ {i}] /\ IF num[i] > max[self] THEN /\ max' = [max EXCEPT ![self] = num[i]] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ max' = max /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "e2"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "e3"] /\ UNCHANGED << unchecked, max >>
IF num[i] > max[self] THEN /\ max' = [max EXCEPT ![self] = num[i]] ELSE /\ TRUE /\ max' = max

IF unchecked[self] # {} THEN /\ \E i \in unchecked[self]: /\ nxt' = [nxt EXCEPT ![self] = i] /\ ~ flag[nxt'[self]] /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "w2"] ELSE /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "cs"] /\ nxt' = nxt
TupleConstructor: << num, flag, pc, unchecked, max, nxt >>
UnchangedExprs: UNCHANGED << num, flag, unchecked, max, nxt >>
LeadsToOp: (\E i \in Procs : Trying(i)) ~> (\E i \in Procs : InCS(i))
